_buckets.aliases: former -> current. basis 'exact' = identical ISO date and parcel cell; 'overlap J=' = same 段/小段 with the parcels overlapping above the threshold, i.e. a scope change
_buckets.ambiguous: several current projects match equally well; needs a human
_buckets.unmatched: nothing above the threshold; the cache directory is stranded
